name: Softrock Minerals Ltd.
summary: Softrock Minerals Ltd. engages in the exploration and development of oil and gas in Canada. The company also explores for lithium, nickel, and cobalt deposits. It holds a 3% gross overriding royalty (GORR) interest on three wells located in the Grand Forks area of Alberta; and 2.5% GORR located in the Charlie Lake field in the Spirit River area of Northern Alberta. The company also owns interests in seven industrial mineral permits for the exploration and development of potash and lithium covering 42,019 hectares situated in Alberta. Softrock Minerals Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
